text:
emma: quick spike — client asked for "auto-fallback" to q4_0 when primary throws transient 5xx. what's the lean console surface to configure/monitor?

anil: I think two knobs: trigger (error rate/window) and fallback target (model/version). plus a visible indicator in request traces.

priya: also need sampling for audit. we shouldn't route 100% to fallback w/out collecting a subset of primary outputs for QA.

josh: agree. UI should default to 'sample primary 1%' and 'fallback 5% after 10 errors/60s' or similar.

sasha: operator story: ability to pause fallback and force primary for an org. maybe a single toggle in rollout detail page.

emma: good. what about degrade modes? options: 'transparent' (returns fallback reply), 'stale-cache' (cached last good), 'placeholder' (client-visible degrade banner), 'noop' (429). need names shorter.

anil: rename: 'silent-replace', 'serve-cache', 'client-notice', 'fail-fast'. each has telemetry implications.

priya: telemetry: every fallback event should emit event with fields: original_model, fallback_model, trigger_metric, sampledump_id. We need audit-bot to capture sample dumps.

josh: sample dumps must be opt-in per customer. privacy/legal will insist. default: hashed prompt + output length + tkn counts.

emma: console mock idea: rollout detail -> Degrade policy card with: Trigger (error% + window), Mode (dropdown), Sampling (primary/secondary %), Overrides (org-level toggle). quick edit inline.

sasha: can we show real-time heatmap of fallback rate and rollback risk score? small sparkline + risk color.

anil: backend needs event id correlation. suggested minimal policy JSON snippet:

```json
{ "trigger": { "type": "error_rate", "window_s": 60, "threshold": 0.05 }, "mode": "silent-replace", "fallback": "gpt4-quant-v1", "sample_primary_pct": 0.01, "sample_fallback_pct": 0.005 }
```

priya: love that. but we also need operator audit log entries when fallback toggles auto->manual. include who/when/reason.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: autofallback-service v1.14 -> staging @ 2026-03-21T15:20Z :rocket:

josh: UX question: show "expected latency delta" when picking fallback target? helps ops trade cost vs latency.

emma: yes. console should show estimated p50 & cost/unit for chosen model & sample sizes.

sasha: edge: cascading fallback: what if fallback also errors? need second-level fallback or circuit-breaker. display hierarchy in UI.

anil: ok add "fallback_chain": list-of-models + policy on stop conditions. default chain length=2.

priya: final ask: make audit exportable csv for compliance with fields: timestamp, event_id, user, org, primary_model, fallback_model, trigger, sample_path.

emma: thanks. i'll sketch a proto and drop in design channel. TL;DR: small Degrade card with Trigger, Mode, Sampling, Overrides, Chain, Audit. thoughts?

josh: :thumbsup: sounds actionable.

sasha: minor: use 'client-notice' label instead of 'show-degrade' for clarity.

emma: noted. ping me for review when mock ready.

audit-bot: Audit stream: new schema registered 'autofallback.v1' (fields: event_id, trigger, primary_sha, fallback_sha, sampling).

priya: perfect — we'll loop legal for sample policy and then iterate.

emma: end.
